rules.statement: The plaintiff's claim to the Viharadhipathiship based on deed P6 is unsuccessful, but he is still recognized as the senior pupil of Rev. Saranatissa Maha Thero.
rules.supporting_quote: (1) That though the plaintiff's claim to the Viharadhipathiship of the temple based on deed P6 cannot be sustained, on the basis of the dates and names of the robbing and ordaining tutors, he is the senior pupil of Rev. Saranatissa Maha Thero.
